requirements.statement: A project hold the update takeover left unverified (releasing, no takeover obligation row, run listed in an adopted takeover journal) is not reported as hold_overdue.
Such a hold is reported as its own plain finding, hold_unverified_takeover, once per project, saying it is harmless, takes no run slot, will not clear by itself and needs nothing.
The driver stops retrying settlement of a run whose hold the takeover left unverified: it is identified once, remembered, and never attempted again by that service, with no release or account change.
docs/troubleshooting.md Update hand-over explains in plain words the run an update left counted because its records could not be checked.
Verified takeover rows and genuinely overdue holds behave exactly as before.
